name: fix93_arrow_dodge
verifies: fix-93 (owner: 'NPC archers always hit; in the original you could dodge'): an NPC's arrow is aimed once at release at where the hero is (G3 _AI_Shoot PathStyle Line; gCProjectile_PS::ShootIteration re-aims only Missile) and flies straight on: standing, the hero is hit; a step aside after the release dodges it.
steps: spawn Orc_Scout_02 attitude=neutral dist=16 side=front as=archer
log -- standing still: the arrows hit
log -- a run sideways at each release: the arrows miss
notes: Orc_Scout_02 shoots from >10 m (combat_ai weaponChoice). The flight of 16 m at 27.8 m/s takes ~0.58 s; a 0.5 s side run (~2 m) takes the hero out of the line. If the archer walks closer than 7 m it draws its melee weapon: check the log. Before fix-93 the arrows were re-aimed every frame and hit whatever he did.
